result.instructions: Tools for Reviewshake, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show our five-star reviews from the last 30 days."; "List the locations on our Reviewshake account."; "Subscribe jane@example.com to the order created campaign for our Main Street location.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Reviewshake data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reviewshake_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reviewshake_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reviewshake_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. reviewshake_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (branches) on this Reviewshake account, with their slugs. Use a location slug in reviewshake_subscribe_customer. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/locations.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List reviews collected for this account, newest first, with rating, text and source. Filter by rating, client, location, review source or date range. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/reviews.

rating.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

client_slug.description: Only the client with this slug (from the Reviewshake dashboard).

location.description: Only reviews for this location name.

source_name.description: Only reviews from this review source, for example Google or Facebook.

start_date.description: Only reviews on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Only reviews on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number (default 1). A page past the last one returns an empty list.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_invitations
tools.title: List review invitations
tools.description: List the review invitations Reviewshake has sent, optionally for one client. Use it to check whether a customer was invited. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/invitations.

client_slug.description: Only the client with this slug (from the Reviewshake dashboard).

page.description: Page number (default 1). A page past the last one returns an empty list.

tools.name: reviewshake_list_widgets
tools.title: List widgets
tools.description: List the review widgets (embeddable review displays) on this account, with their type and settings. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/widgets.

tools.name: reviewshake_get_widget
tools.title: Get a widget
tools.description: Get one review widget by id, with its type and settings. Reviewshake API: GET /api/v1/widgets/{id}.

tools.name: reviewshake_subscribe_customer
tools.title: Subscribe a customer to a campaign
tools.description: Subscribe one customer to a review campaign, so Reviewshake sends them a review invitation. This contacts a real person: send only when the user asked. Give an email or a phone number. Reviewshake API: POST /api/v1/customer/subscribe.

campaign_name.description: The campaign name as set in Reviewshake, for example "order created".

client.description: The client name the customer belongs to.

location_slug.description: The location slug the customer belongs to (from reviewshake_list_locations).

email.description: The customer's email address. Optional when a phone number is given.

phone.description: The customer's phone number in international format, for example +12025550123.

annotations.title: Subscribe a customer to a campaign

tools.name: reviewshake_unsubscribe_customer
tools.title: Unsubscribe a customer
tools.description: Stop review invitations for one customer, found by email or phone. This changes who gets messages: send only when the user asked. Reviewshake API: POST /api/v1/customer/unsubscribe.

client.description: The client name the customer belongs to.

email.description: The customer's email address. Optional when a phone number is given.

phone.description: The customer's phone number in international format.

tools.name: reviewshake_create_widget
tools.title: Create a widget
tools.description: Create a review widget (an embeddable review display) with the chosen type. The widget is public once embedded on a site. Reviewshake API: POST /api/v1/widgets.

ex_star_rating.description: Star ratings to leave out of the widget, for example [1, 2].

max_reviews.description: The most reviews the widget shows.

tools.name: reviewshake_delete_widget
tools.title: Delete a widget
tools.description: Delete one review widget. It cannot be undone, and embeds of it stop working. Pass confirm: true only when the user asked for this deletion. Reviewshake API: DELETE /api/v1/widgets/{id}.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only when the user asked for this deletion.

tools.name: reviewshake_delete_review_sources
tools.title: Delete review sources
tools.description: Delete one or more review sources (the Google, Facebook or other review pages the account collects from). It cannot be undone. Pass confirm: true only when the user asked for this deletion. Reviewshake API: DELETE /api/v1/bulk_review_sources.

source_ids.description: The review source ids to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only when the user asked for this deletion.
